module: WebSocket client backend of lua-websockets for the cooperative 'copas' library (non-blocking sockets in coroutines). The module returns a constructor function; the returned object is extended by websocket/sync (connect, send, receive, close methods).
usage:
local newClient = require('libs/lua-websockets/websocket/client_copas')
local ws = newClient({timeout = 2})
-- to be called in a copas coroutine:
ws:connect('ws://127.0.0.1:8080', 'proto')
notes: I/O goes through copas.connect/send/receive/dohandshake, so calls must be made from a coroutine managed by copas.

client.desc: Object returned by the constructor new(ws). ws is an optional options table (timeout field in seconds). The connect/send/receive/close methods come from websocket/sync; the sock_* methods below provide the transport.

sock_connect.desc: Creates a TCP socket (luasocket), applies ws.timeout and connects via copas.connect. Returns nil and the error on failure (except 'already connected').

sock_send.desc: Sends data via copas.send on the socket.

sock_receive.desc: Reads data via copas.receive on the socket.

dohandshake.desc: Delegates to copas.dohandshake (TLS negotiation) on the socket.
